releaseNotes:

• Onboarding & Sidepanel Redesign: Added smooth fade transitions with an expanding progress rail, bento sidepanel layout, pastel gradient, and elevated daily streak card
• Stability & Lint Hardening: Fixed API 31+ splash screen theme attributes and widget RemoteViews spacer compatibility
